name: star-writing-skills
description: A general research-paper toolkit for framing, literature, methods, evidence, drafting, revision, review, and submission.

interface.shortDescription: Build defensible research papers from idea to submission.
interface.longDescription: A modular, cross-disciplinary research-paper system for framing, literature positioning, technical method audits, evidence design, drafting, prose polishing, purpose-specific review, and live submission checks.
defaultPrompt: Turn these research materials into a defensible paper plan.
Draft or revise a manuscript section from verified claims and evidence.
Audit this manuscript's method, claims, evidence, and consistency.
